
### Trailer quality, startup and source warmup

- Inline and fullscreen trailers both request the highest supported rendition, including 4K when available. Removed the inline 720p cap.
- Verify the highest-quality video/audio pair first instead of probing every fallback before playback. Use legacy extraction only when the maintained resolver cannot provide a readable rendition.
- Share short-lived resolved trailer URLs between details, inline and fullscreen playback. Warm trailer URLs while reading details and during the configured hover delay; failed lookups can be retried immediately.
- Start title-source prefetch before trailer resolution. Warmup survives trailer dismissal and remains reusable for five minutes after completion. Episode warmup uses refreshed account progress.
- Add source-warmup readiness/reuse diagnostics and trailer preparation-to-first-frame timing.
- Remove unsafe focus re-entry targeting detached content requesters. Move fullscreen focus away from controls before they auto-hide, addressing the main-thread focus crash seen in 0.1.84-beta.

Startup improvements target faster playback; an under-two-second cold start cannot be guaranteed because YouTube resolution, network speed and device decoding vary. Physical-TV confirmation of the reported crash fix and startup timing is still required.
